{{Quote|This one's for Alderaan.|Fenn Signis|<ref name="FFGweb" />}}
'''Fenn Signis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served as a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel trooper]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's destruction]], he joined [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] .

==History==
{{Quote|Give the signal, and I'll drop those troopers like mynocks.|Fenn Signis|<ref name="FFGweb" />}}
A native of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Fenn Signis joined the Rebellion at the age of seventeen and became an exemplary [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. After completing two tours of duty with the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]], Signis was stationed at the [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] on [[Arda I]] when he learned of his [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|homeworld's destruction]] at the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|hands]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="FFGweb" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rebels abandoned the Arda I base<ref name="OaAI">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref> and Signis joined [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] vowing to avenge his lost homeworld and bring an end to the Empire's reign of terror.<ref name="FFGweb" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|If it can kill a trooper, I can make it work.|Fenn Signis|<ref name="FFGweb" />}}
Signis was a dedicated soldier loyal to the Rebel Alliance. He was a weapons expert, and was as dangerous working alone as he was working with a squad of SpecForces [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. He possessed a knack for gaining an advantageous position over his enemies, making him a very dangerous opponent.<ref name="FFGweb" />
